g.text: The predeclared static-signed fallback was selected on consumed development data; the primary missed its retained research MAPE gate.

g.text: All earlier 192 / 327 / 32 / 40 / 40 / 32 panels are consumed. The fresh 40-case cohort was frozen separately; no learning curve is implied.

g.text: Experimental isolated iCE40 LUT4 point estimates only. No calibrated safety, full-CPU, timing, power or application-transfer guarantee. Base stays the default.
